recipe.formula: resize generated plane interior cubic; match its channel means to source plane; add smoothed source row+column variation minus2*source mean; round/clip.
recipe.geometry_scope: Original rectangles partition every output pixel once; generated boundaries are discarded by interior projection.
recipe.material_provenance: Built-in image_gen external material, one call. Prior local WDN geometric edit was supplied as target; not an all-local result.

recipe.coordinate_correction: Original traced samples were recorded as pixel indices; add.5 to both x/y to render at pixel centers. All earlier trace records remain unchanged.

source_curve_diagnostics.limit: Sampled original highlight centers with adjacent crossing arm excluded. Trace/center agreement is not proof of consumer geometry or every edge.

gpt.whole_generated_image_decision: held pending exact source-plane/color correction; generated image alone is not adopted
